narr: Numerous showers and thunderstorms occurred along a stationary front that extended from the Great Lakes southward across the lower Mississippi Valley. Locally excessive rainfall produced extensive road flooding in Calloway County.
ev: Numerous rural county roads were either flooded or completely washed out from near Almo to Dexter and surrounding areas.
lsr: NUMEROUS RURAL COUNTY ROADS ARE EITHER FLOODED OR COMPLETELY WASHED OUT FROM NEAR ALMO TO DEXTER AND SURROUNDING AREAS.
